title: The code that runs, in order

steps.title: Four stages, four source trees
steps.body:
The picture lists the files to open when you want to understand or change a boot step, in the order they run: SPL, BL31, U-Boot, Linux. The paths are inside `build/src/` after a build.

Each file is explained with real code in `docs/15-source-tour.md`.

steps.title: SPL brings up DRAM
steps.body:
The SPL (secondary program loader, U-Boot's tiny first stage) starts in `board_init_f()`: clocks, UART, PMIC, then DRAM. `spl_dram_init()` reads the SoM EEPROM and adjusts timings, and `ddr_init.c` loads the training firmware into the PHY.

`enable_tzc380()` in `soc.c` switches on the TZASC, and `spl_fit.c` reads the FIT image and jumps to BL31.

steps.title: BL31 is the secure monitor that stays resident
steps.body:
The `imx-atf` tree holds BL31. `bl31_main.c` is the generic TF-A start-up: runtime services, then exit to BL33 (U-Boot).

`imx8mp_bl31_setup.c` sets the CSU/RDC/TZASC rules and the BL33 entry at `0x4020_0000` at EL2.

steps.title: PSCI and SiP calls are BL31's services
steps.body:
`imx_pwr_domain_on()` is how PSCI `CPU_ON` powers a core. `imx_sip_svc.c` handles the `0xC2…` NXP SiP calls such as DDR DVFS and GPC.

Linux reaches these through `smc` instructions.

steps.title: U-Boot customises itself for the board
steps.body:
`board_late_init()` reads the EEPROM to set `board_name` and the console. `imx8mp_var_dart.env` is the default environment holding `bsp_bootcmd` and `findfdt`.

`cmd/booti.c` relocates the Image, passes the DTB in `x0` and jumps.

steps.title: Linux starts in assembly
steps.body: `head.S` holds the first kernel instructions: MMU on, EL2 stub, then C. `psci.c` implements `psci_0_2_cpu_on()` which ends in `arm_smccc_smc()`, the call into BL31.

steps.title: Drivers bind through the device tree
steps.body:
`drivers/of/platform.c` turns DT nodes into devices and `i2c-imx.c` is the I2C controller driver. `rtc-ds1307.c` contains the `of_match_table` and `ds1307_probe()` for the board's RTC.

The same compatible string is in the device tree.

steps.title: init/main.c hands over to userspace
steps.body:
`kernel_init()` calls `run_init_process("/sbin/init")`, the last step of this map.

From here on it is just Linux.

steps.anchor: Each file is explained, with the real code, in docs/15-source-tour.md. Grep tips: grep -rn "bsp_bootcmd" build/src/uboot-imx/board/variscite/ ·
steps.title: Takeaway: grep for a string to find the file
steps.body: Grep the tree for a variable, compatible string or constant, such as `bsp_bootcmd`, `dallas,ds1337` or `IMX_SIP_`, to land in the right file.
